data.long_meaning: In Greek, Alaster comes from the root words 'alas' meaning 'aloft, high' and 'ter' meaning 'strong, powerful'. This name signifies an exalted, noble being, one who is strong and powerful in spirit. The name Alaster carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alaster usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Alaster
